general_information.name: WELL, MY NAME’S MICHAEL… I MEAN, THAT’S WHAT I USUALLY GO BY. DO YOU MEAN THE WHOLE THING EXACTLY AS IT WOULD BE ON PAPERWORK AND ALL THAT? I’M A BIT MIXED UP ON HOW YOU WANT IT WRITTEN DOWN.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly… waves of sadness, really, and missing my wife. She died from cancer about a year ago, and around anniversaries I’ll cry and get hit harder, but I’m still working and sleeping okay enough, and I do see friends.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly I want to learn how to live with the loss, you know… keep going the way she would’ve wanted.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yeah… I did go to a bereavement group after my wife died. It was through hospice, and I think it was about eight sessions in 2025.; In 2025, as far as I remember.; About 8 sessions.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Just the high cholesterol, that’s the only one I know of.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Beer.; Quantity or frequency: Two on weekends.; Duration: About forty years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Marchmont Consulting.; Job Title: Civil engineer.; Dates: From 1991 to Present.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Cork, and we moved to Toronto when I was 8. It was a warm family, really… not much else to say, just a pretty normal childhood, I suppose.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I did my engineering degree and, honestly, there weren’t any big difficulties that stand out. It was just… school and then moving on with things.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Well, I was married—widowed now. The marriage lasted 33 years, and we have two adult children nearby.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to keep working, see my grandchildren, and maybe travel a little… just a bit, nothing too wild.
